verification.scope: Data identity, exact canonical metadata, exclusion/non-overlap, immutable controls, native parent compatibility and narrow historical-source references. Does not execute the parent-owned bench service or browser.

fixture.basis: Absolute abstract fixture budget, not bonuses to named armour. A bench must execute its explicit native mechanism instead of a generic armour duel.

primaryEvidenceReused.established: Numbered powers use finite Power Cells replenished at ammo caches and have no recharge time; unnumbered powers use cooldown.
notEstablished: Special ammunition consumable duration or clip/shot consumption
primaryEvidenceReused.actionFixture: MEA-POW-FRAG / fragGrenade is an existing ATB demonstration command, not a new primary certification that this named power uses the manual’s generic cell rule.
